type:
∀ (s : Sonification.Mat008.State) (row : Sonification.Mat008.ParsedRow),
  s.conflict = true → (Sonification.Mat008.step s row).conflict = true

∀ (s : Sonification.Mat008.State) (row : Sonification.Mat008.ParsedRow) (campaign : String),
  (Sonification.Mat008.step s row).conflict = false →
    Sonification.Mat008.lookup s.owner row.originalRun = some campaign → campaign = row.campaign

∀ (rows : List Sonification.Mat008.ParsedRow),
  (Sonification.Mat008.scan rows).conflict = false → Sonification.Mat008.Covers (Sonification.Mat008.scan rows) rows

∀ (s : Sonification.Mat008.State) (rows : List Sonification.Mat008.ParsedRow) (row : Sonification.Mat008.ParsedRow),
  Sonification.Mat008.Covers s rows →
    (Sonification.Mat008.step s row).conflict = false →
      Sonification.Mat008.Covers (Sonification.Mat008.step s row) (rows ++ [row])

∀ {α : Type} (motive : List α → Prop),
  motive [] → (∀ (rows : List α) (row : α), motive rows → motive (rows ++ [row])) → ∀ (rows : List α), motive rows

(Sonification.Mat008.scan
        [{ campaign := "A", originalRun := "RUN" }, { campaign := "B", originalRun := "RUN" },
          { campaign := "B", originalRun := "OTHER" }]).conflict =
    true ∧
  (Sonification.Mat008.scan
        [{ campaign := "A", originalRun := "RUN_A" }, { campaign := "B", originalRun := "RUN_B" }]).conflict =
    false

∀ (rows : List Sonification.Mat008.ParsedRow) (row : Sonification.Mat008.ParsedRow),
  Sonification.Mat008.scan (rows ++ [row]) = Sonification.Mat008.step (Sonification.Mat008.scan rows) row

∀ (s : Sonification.Mat008.State) (xs ys : List Sonification.Mat008.ParsedRow),
  Sonification.Mat008.scanFrom s (xs ++ ys) = Sonification.Mat008.scanFrom (Sonification.Mat008.scanFrom s xs) ys

∀ (s : Sonification.Mat008.State) (row : Sonification.Mat008.ParsedRow),
  (Sonification.Mat008.step s row).conflict = false → s.conflict = false
